summary: The /live/ hub page: three cards (Walkthrough → /demo/, Graph → /graph/, Notebook → /notebook/) so the homepage's CTA doesn't have to pick one of the three real-data pages for the visitor — it links here instead of straight to /graph/. Plain new-page chrome (landing.css + Nav/Footer/SvgDefs, `Nav variant="live"`), no dependency beyond an inline `cards` array mapped to `.livecard` anchors.
